# Internet Archive

> > A non-profit digital library offering free access to millions of books, movies, software, music, websites, and more, including the Wayback Machine for archived web pages.

The Internet Archive provides tools for downloading collections in various formats (PDF, ePUB, ZIP) and accessing archived web content. Users can interact with the archive through web interfaces, command-line tools, Python libraries, and wget for bulk downloads.

## Key Topics

- Internet Archive
- Wayback Machine
- wget
- Internet Archive Command-line Tool
- Python
- Bulk downloads
- File formats (PDF, ePUB, ZIP)
- Command-line tools
- Archived webpages
- Download options
- Unix tools
- Alexa Internet
- Digital preservation

## Downloading and Access Guides

- [Downloading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide/): Comprehensive guide to downloading files from Internet Archive using wget, command-line tools, and various download options for bulk access
